notes: Manifest v101 closes the same-tab canonical-render gap exposed by Whole Conversation Camera. When account-state hydration writes newer server-owned state through the sync layer, the same browser document now adopts that cache change into Chat's in-memory view; a server-terminal assistant correlated by requestId also retires the stale active controller so a completed canonical response cannot remain rendered as Writing response. Server/account authority remains unchanged and the bridge performs no cognition or durable writes.
